title: Find Largest Value in Each Tree Row
statement: Return the largest value in each row (level) of the tree, from top to bottom.
reference_solution:
def largestValues(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    while level:
        out.append(max(n.val for n in level))
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
    return out

hints.1_question: You need one answer per level. What traversal groups nodes by level?
hints.2_nudge: Level-order traversal: for each level take the maximum of its values.
hints.3_big_hint: out.append(max(n.val for n in level)) for each level, then build the next level.

known_bugs.name: max starts at 0 (negative rows come out wrong)
